_doc.iso3: ISO-639-3 code used for the romanization of the forced alignment (align_forced.py)
_doc.premiere_language: language tag written in a Premiere JSON when the original has none
_doc.default_speaker_name: speaker name used when the original Premiere JSON has no speaker
_doc.word_chars: accented letters kept when words are compared (a-z and 0-9 are always kept)
_doc.lead_punct: characters peeled off the start of a token as leading punctuation (build_subs.py)
_doc.trail_punct: characters peeled off the end of a token as trailing punctuation (build_subs.py)
_doc.quote_char: default quote mark put around titles of works
_doc.typography: spacing rules of the language: default_on = applied unless corrections.json says otherwise; nbsp_before / nbsp_after = characters that get a no-break space before / after them; detached_punct = a token made only of these (plus . , ...) is glued back to the previous word
_doc.normalize_words: spelling normalizations, each {pattern, base}: a match is replaced by base (keeps a final plural s and an initial capital); used when corrections.json has normalize_cotes
_doc.eos_closers: characters allowed after . ! ? ... before the end of a word for it to still end a sentence
_doc.token_break_punct: a whisper token starting with one of these starts a new word (transcribe.py)
_doc.empty_token_placeholder: word used when a token is empty once punctuation is removed, to keep the 1:1 mapping in forced alignment
_doc.whisper_hallucinations: lines whisper invents on silence; to delete with a seq_rule N->0 (reference list, not read by the scripts)
